candidates.name: Dermatomyositis
support_spans: Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Diffuse poikiloderma involving upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Radiographic evidence of myositis
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)
Presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with dermatomyositis, a condition characterized by skin and muscle inflammation.
